# Provenance of ../swift-report.txt. A real run; nothing hand-written.
command:  swiftPlugin.CoverageCmd(["swift", "test"]) run in this directory, stdout only
          (TestCapturedCoverageReportsMatchALiveRun, CORRALAI_RECAPTURE_COVERAGE=1), from a
          CGO_ENABLED=0 `go test -c` binary of internal/lang run in a container of the
          corral-swift-spike image (swift:6.3.2-noble with libmysqlclient-dev and pkg-config)
          as the invoking user, with the network off. Its awk is mawk.
swift:    Swift version 6.3.2 (swift-6.3.2-RELEASE)   Target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
captured: 2026-11-19
reproduced: 2026-11-20, unchanged, by the same test's live run on Swift 6.4.2 (swift-6.4.2-RELEASE) in a
          container of swift:6.4.2-resolute (Ubuntu 26.04) with Go added, network off, once with its
          mawk and once with gawk as awk, and again on 6.3.2. Reproduced again on 2026-11-20, unchanged,
          after CoverageCmd began merging the run's profiles and exporting them itself over every test
          product (llvmCovMergeExportShell) under the toolchain's default build system: on Swift 6.3.2
          (corral-swift-t9, native) and on Swift 6.4.2 (swiftbuild) with mawk and with gawk as awk.
trimmed:  nothing. The reducer prints working-directory-relative paths, so the report carries no machine path.
fixture:  Sources/Calc/Calc.swift  add is tested, sub is not                  -> 0 < executed < executable
          Sources/Calc/Dead.swift  compiled, never called                     -> executed 0
          Sources/Calc/Shape.swift a protocol, no function body               -> absent (llvm-cov maps no line)
          Unbuilt/Orphan.swift     in no target, never built                  -> absent
          Tests/CalcTests/CalcTests.swift      the swift-testing test         -> executed
          Tests/CalcXCTests/CalcXCTests.swift  the XCTest test                -> executed
          .build/corral-coverage/...  the test runner and discovery sources SwiftPM generates -> absent (skipped)
The raw export of the same fixture is ../../runners/swift-codecov.json
(scripts/capture-runner-fixtures.sh --swift-coverage-only); TestSwiftCapturedReportIsTheCapturedExportReduced
